name: Single-cell processing inside semi-permeable capsules on assayathon_demo
description: Generated by autochip from 'Single-cell processing inside semi-permeable capsules'. Objective is simplest_to_make. Cell preparation (steps 1-6, 8, 9), cold gelation, split, index PCR, shell digestion and bead clean-up stay at the bench, where the lab has the incubator, centrifuge, cold plate, thermocycler and pipette. Three chips remain. (1) Oil-phase encapsulation, kept apart from everything else. (2) Emulsion breaking, photocuring on the led_405nm, washes and aggregate filtering. (3) Lysis, washes and RT in a trap. Index PCR (up to 95 C) is above the 50 C limit of the resin, so split and PCR go off chip to the thermocycler. Shell digestion (step 22) also goes off chip. Re-split fix: both traps now use mesh retention with a 25 um pore, under 0.4 x the 70 um capsule size (28 um), in place of 60 um pillars, which let capsules slip through. The cell filter (step 7) needs about 30 um, below the 60 um process minimum, so it is listed as missing.

modules.name: Encapsulation chip
modules.note: Cells in core solution are pinched into shell-polymer droplets by fluorinated oil at a flow-focusing junction.

modules.name: Emulsion break, curing, wash and capsule filter chip
modules.note: Breaks the emulsion, photocures the shells, washes the capsules and removes aggregates.

modules.name: Lysis, wash and reverse transcription chip
modules.note: Lyses the cells, washes, and runs reverse transcription inside the capsules held in one trap.

handoffs.note: droplets by off chip step, through bench step(s) 11

roadmap.name: Bench: step 20
roadmap.note: Split the capsules into four equal portions.

roadmap.name: Bench: step 21
roadmap.note: Run index PCR on each portion with a different index primer mix.

roadmap.name: Bench: step 22
roadmap.note: Release the cDNA by digesting the capsule shells with shell-digesting enzyme.

roadmap.name: Bench: step 23
roadmap.note: Bind the library to magnetic beads.

roadmap.name: Bench: step 24
roadmap.note: Wash the beads with ethanol wash solution on a magnet.

roadmap.name: Bench: step 25
roadmap.note: Elute the library from the beads in water.

roadmap.name: Bench: step 26
roadmap.note: Measure library concentration and fragment size.
